document.title: Joint Advisory AA26-113A: Ransomware activity targeting health care providers

techniques.note: Listed in the ATT&CK table and described in prose (unpatched deserialisation flaw in a patient-portal appliance).
'mail carrying a document attachment that purported to be a remittance advice' -- absent from the advisory's own ATT&CK table.
'registering a task with the operating system scheduler' -- absent from the ATT&CK table.

notes: Worked example, deliberately the opposite shape to 0001: an advisory that publishes its own partial ATT&CK table, so the regex baseline recovers 3 of 5 techniques for free. The two implicit techniques are the ones the advisory's table omits, which is the realistic gap -- advisory tables are routinely incomplete. Pairing this with 0001 keeps the baseline from looking either uselessly weak or unrealistically strong.
